site.title: WORLDSMITH
site.tagline: Explorable Halloween worlds — rendered as light, walked as splats

worlds.title: Graveyard in the Fog
worlds.description: A fog-drowned churchyard at midnight. Tilted stones, a lone candle on a stone plinth, mist swallowing everything past ten feet.

worlds.title: The Stone Angel
worlds.description: A Victorian cemetery under a towering eroded angel. Dozens of votive candles flicker at its base while fog walls close in.

worlds.title: The Open Crypt
worlds.description: A crumbling mausoleum, doors ajar, candlelight spilling onto the steps. Blood-orange moon over wild grass.

worlds.title: Hillside Cemetery
worlds.description: A lantern-lit path winds up between leaning graves toward a shrine on the hill. Crescent moon, ruined chapel.

worlds.title: Graveyard in the Fog (first draft)
worlds.description: The original draft — kept for comparison. Iron fence, crescent moon, chaotic stones.
worlds.note: splat reuses plus-tier file for viewer testing

worlds.title: The Stone Angel (first draft)
worlds.description: The original draft of the angel — votive candles, claustrophobic fog.

worlds.title: Autumn Graveyard at Dusk
worlds.description: Jack-o'-lantern on a fresh grave, pumpkins at the gate, first stars over the forest edge.
